name: Luminous Wrath
body:
School evocation [good, light]; Level: champion of light 4, cleric 5, inquisitor 5

Components: V, S

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Touch

Target(s): Object touched

Duration: 10 min./level (D)

Saving Throw: None; Spell Resistance: yes (see below)

This spell functions identically to the luminous retribution spell. Additionally, if this spell is used in an area occupied by magic darkness, it acts as a dispel magic against it.

If it successfully dispels the darkness, it also causes 1d4 damage per level of the caster (max 10d4), no save (although spell resistance applies), to the creature that created the darkness, provided the creature is within 100 ft. of the object radiating this spell. Only one dispel attempt is allowed per casting of this spell.
